title: STAT3 Is the Master Regulator for the Forming of 3D Spheroids of 3T3-L1 Preadipocytes.
authors: Ohguro, Hiroshi; Ida, Yosuke; Hikage, Fumihito; Umetsu, Araya; Ichioka, Hanae; Watanabe, Megumi; Furuhashi, Masato
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA-seq和IPA分析3T3-L1前脂肪细胞3D球体形成中的上游调控因子，虽涉及STAT3等转录因子，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属转录组学与通路分析。
abstract: To elucidate the currently unknown mechanisms responsible for the diverse biological aspects between two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) cultured 3T3-L1 preadipocytes, RNA-sequencing analyses were performed. During a 7-day culture period, 2D- and 3D-cultured 3T3-L1 cells were subjected to lipid staining by BODIPY, qPCR for adipogenesis related genes, including peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (Ppargamma), CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein alpha (Cebpa), Ap2 (fatty acid-binding protein 4; Fabp4), leptin, and AdipoQ (adiponectin), and RNA-sequencing analysis. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were detected by next-generation RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and validated by a quantitative reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Bioinformatic analyses were performed on DEGs using a Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis and an Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA). Significant spontaneous adipogenesis was observed in 3D 3T3-L1 spheroids, but not in 2D-cultured cells. The mRNA expression of Ppargamma, Cebpa, and Ap2 among the five genes tested were significantly higher in 3D spheroids than in 2D-cultured cells, thus providing support for this conclusion. RNA analysis demonstrated that a total of 826 upregulated and 725 downregulated genes were identified as DEGs. GO enrichment analysis and IPA found 50 possible upstream regulators, and among these, 6 regulators-transforming growth factor beta1 (TGFbeta1), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), interleukin 6 (IL6), angiotensinogen (AGT), FOS, and MYC-were, in fact, significantly upregulated. Further analyses of these regulators by causal networks of the top 14 predicted diseases and functions networks (IPA network score indicated more than 30), suggesting that STAT3 was the most critical upstream regulator. The findings presented herein suggest that STAT3 has a critical role in regulating the unique biological properties of 3D spheroids that are produced from 3T3-L1 preadipocytes.
abstract_zh: 为阐明二维（2D）与三维（3D）培养的3T3-L1前脂肪细胞在多种生物学特性上目前未知的机制，进行了RNA测序分析。在7天培养期间，对2D和3D培养的3T3-L1细胞进行了BODIPY脂质染色、脂肪生成相关基因（包括过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（Ppargamma）、CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白α（Cebpa）、Ap2（脂肪酸结合蛋白4；Fabp4）、瘦素和AdipoQ（脂联素））的qPCR检测，以及RNA测序分析。通过下一代RNA测序（RNA-seq）检测差异表达基因（DEGs），并使用定量逆转录聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）进行验证。对DEGs进行了基因本体（GO）富集分析和Ingenuity通路分析（IPA）等生物信息学分析。在3D 3T3-L1球体中观察到显著的自发脂肪生成，而在2D培养细胞中未观察到。在所测试的五个基因中，Ppargamma、Cebpa和Ap2的mRNA表达在3D球体中显著高于2D培养细胞，从而支持了这一结论。RNA分析显示，共鉴定出826个上调基因和725个下调基因作为DEGs。GO富集分析和IPA发现了50个可能的上游调控因子，其中6个调控因子——转化生长因子β1（TGFbeta1）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、白细胞介素6（IL6）、血管紧张素原（AGT）、FOS和MYC——实际上显著上调。通过前14个预测疾病和功能网络的因果网络对这些调控因子进行进一步分析（IPA网络评分显示超过30），表明STAT3是最关键的上游调控因子。本文的研究结果表明，STAT3在调控由3T3-L1前脂肪细胞产生的3D球体的独特生物学特性中发挥关键作用。
